name: simplepost
description: Publish, schedule, preview, and manage social posts with SimplePost, or add SimplePost publishing to an application.

interface.longDescription: A flagship SimplePost skill for publishing, scheduling, drafting, previewing, inspecting, and managing posts across connected social accounts. It also guides developers through the CLI, HTTP API, Scheduler app, and TypeScript SDK when integrating social publishing into an application.
